title: Fourier one norm bounds pointwise values
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the Boolean cube $\{-1,1\}^n$. At every point $x$ of the cube, the absolute value $|f(x)|$ is at most the sum of the absolute values of all Fourier coefficients of $f$.
